title: Lease coalescer and granular burst telemetry adapter
author: Nadia Park
release_notes: Introduce lease coalescer to reduce reservation churn and a telemetry adapter that emits 1s/10s utilization snapshots and percentile-tail reports. Config flags added to Dedicated config. Backwards compatible by default.
body: Summary: This PR introduces two coordinated pieces: (1) a lease coalescer in the fleet allocator that groups short-lived reservation requests into a small number of soft leases to reduce churn and headroom volatility; (2) a granular burst telemetry adapter that emits compact per-tenant utilization snapshots (1s/10s windows) plus 50/90/99 pctl tail estimates used by alerting and the autoscaler. Motivation: we observed elevated provisioning and eviction churn during high-cardinality microbursts (customer incidents SUP-442) which led to tail latency spikes and unstable autoscaler oscillation. Coalescing ephemeral leases reduces control-plane operations and smooths utilization signals; the new telemetry adapter provides the autoscaler and ops with higher fidelity burst signals without increasing storage cost.

b9d82af: add burst telemetry adapter and snapshot format + proto and validation

description_details: Design notes: The lease coalescer watches reservation requests for ephemeral allocations (<= 20s) and groups compatible requests by tenant, model-family and requested sequence length into a soft lease window (configurable: default 5s coalesce window). A soft lease is a short-lived reservation that the runtime treats as a single backing allocation for scheduling; the coalescer maintains a small in-memory ledger to track effective capacity per soft-lease and periodically reconciles to real GPU reservations. Key properties: 1) no change to customer-visible reservation API; 2) conservative defaults that preserve throughput SLAs; 3) explicit opt-out via tenant config. The burst telemetry adapter hooks into the allocator and scheduler to emit compact snapshots: a 1s high-resolution counter for immediate SLO decisions and an aggregated 10s snapshot for the autoscaler and historical tail computation. The adapter computes 50/90/99 percentiles using a bounded-summary sketch to keep payloads small.
test_and_bench_summary: Unit tests cover coalescer correctness and eviction safety. Integration test simulates interleaved microbursts across 500 tenants; end-to-end test validates stable eviction rates and that the autoscaler does not overshoot during injections. Perf harness results: median CPU overhead on allocator process +2.1%, p99 tail reduction for provisioning ops ~34%, sustained autoscaler oscillation reduced in replay by 42%. See tools/perf outputs attached in CI.
review_comments: Miguel Santos: Please add a short doc explaining the migration/rollback story and how to opt-out per tenant. Also, can you quantify memory impact of the in-memory ledger?

Author (Nadia Park): Added docs/dedicated/lease-coalescer.md and added a per-tenant opt-out flag. Ledger memory is bounded by (tenants_in_window * average_shard_size). In our replay benchmarks peak was ~12MB across 10k tenants; added figures to the doc.
Priya Raman: How does coalescing interact with warm pools and prewarmed slots? We should avoid starving warm pool replenishment.

Author (Nadia Park): Coalescer respects warm pool reservations by marking warm slots as uncoalescible; added unit tests to assert warm pool invariants. Also added a tunable threshold to avoid coalescing when warm pool fill rate < configured target.
Evan Cho: Telemetry schema looks good; ensure downstream consumers validate missing fields (we'll roll forward in Observability). Also request a perf CI run that includes 100ms microburst traces.
Author (Nadia Park): CI perf run added (bench:lease-coalesce:microburst-100ms) and results uploaded to the PR artifacts.
ci_checks: perf-bench:lease-coalesce - initial fail (flaky harness) -> rerun -> pass
observability_and_alerting_changes: Added two new metrics: allocator.soft_leases_active (gauge) and telemetry.burst_snapshot_emitted (counter). Alerting playbook updated: when allocator.soft_leases_active grows > configured threshold for > 60s, generate a low-priority Ops alert and enable diagnostic trace mode for the allocator pipeline. Documentation includes recommended SLI thresholds and dashboard example.
migration_and_rollback: Default behavior is off for tenants that have explicit lease contracts (legacy dedicated customers). Rollout plan: enable as opt-in on staging for 2 weeks, then gradual canary: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with health gates (provisioning ops rate, eviction rate, p99 latency). Rollback: flip feature flag and allow leases to drain for the coalesce window (default 5s). Added migration notes in docs/dedicated/lease-coalescer.md.
post_merge_actions: Create follow-up ENG task to observe tail metrics over 7d in production (ENG-3621). Add a dashboard tile showing 10s burst snapshots by tenant cohort and a Grafana panel that compares coalesced vs non-coalesced provisioning ops.
notes_for_release: This change affects Dedicated allocator behavior and adds new telemetry. No customer API changes. Recommend including short note in release announcements for enterprise customers explaining opt-in rollout and how to opt-out.
